contexts.text: Let man beware of. DSS 118:end. DLW 403. LJPost 234.
Let him take care not to disturb the Church.
Therefore let all take care not to injure the Word in any way...
Therefore let everyone within the Church take care not to deny the Lord...
Let him especially take care not to appropriate to himself any doctrinal which defends evil.
Therefore let everyone beware of confirmations in favour of nature.
Therefore let everyone beware of persuading himself that he lives from himself...
